def slug(text):
    if not text:
        return ""
    # lowercase ASCII letters
    text = text.lower()
    # preserve digits
    text = re.sub(r'[0-9]+', r'\1', text)
    # replace runs of other characters with one hyphen
    text = re.sub(r'[^0-9\-]+', r'-', text)
    # strip edge hyphens
    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    return text
```
